commands.label: Execute exact EdgeQL against a local isolated publisher server

check.sh.content_utf8:
set -eu
"$1" --data-dir=/work/database --runstate-dir=/tmp/gel --bind-address=127.0.0.1 --port=5625 --security=insecure_dev_mode --tls-cert-mode=generate_self_signed >server.log 2>&1 &
p=$!
trap 'kill "$p" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$p" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
for i in $(seq 1 100); do
 if "$2" --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5625 --user admin --branch main --tls-security insecure --wait-until-available 2s query --output-format=json --file hello.edgeql >answer.json 2>query.log; then
  cat answer.json; exit 0
 fi
 if ! kill -0 "$p"; then cat server.log; cat query.log; exit 2; fi
 sleep 0.35
done
cat server.log; cat query.log
exit 3
